1936614758.20021703: Deals damage that ignores 10% of the target's Defense when attacking the enemy. The percentage of Defense ignored increases by 10% whenever the boss gains a turn. [Automatic Effect]
1936614758.20021704: Increases its Attack Bar by 30% whenever the enemy's turn ends. [Automatic Effect]
1936614758.20021801: Attacks all enemies to remove all beneficial effects and grant Oblivion for 1 turn.
1936614758.20021802: Attacks the enemy with the highest Attack Bar 3 times, dealing damage that ignores Defense based on the difference in Attack Speed between the boss and the target, and decreasing its Attack Bar by 30% on each hit.
1936614758.20021803: Whenever its turn ends, decreases the Attack Speed of all enemies for 2 turns with a 50% chance. [Automatic Effect]
1936614758.20021804: Attacks taken from enemies with lower Attack Speed than the boss always land as a Glancing Hit. [Automatic Effect]
1936614758.20021901: Attacks all enemies 4 times. 1936614758.20021902: Attacks the enemy 7 times. First to sixth hits remove 1 beneficial effect with a 20% chance and stun for 1 turn with a 20% chance. The last hit deals damage that ignores all beneficial effects that reduce damage taken.
1936614758.20021903: Attacks the enemy to instantly defeat the target. This skill can be used when the boss has no weapons.

1919251571.53957: You can start battle after setting up all 3 decks, or with just a single deck. <color:ffffff>Monsters, Runes, and Artifacts cannot be used more than once across decks</color>.
1919251571.53958: Each deck can battle for up to <color:ffffff>50 turns</color>. If all Monsters are defeated or all 50 turns are used, you can <color:ffffff>continue the battle with the next deck</color>.
1919251571.55360: Experience a brand-new type of battle in the new event dungeon, <color:ffffff>Land of Shadow</color>.
1919251571.55361: Clear stages to obtain Relic Pieces with special effects.
1919251571.55362: Take on the <color:ffffff>Land of Shadow</color> together with The Lord of the Rings Collab Monsters!
1919251571.55363: During the collab period, you can also enjoy the new minigame, <color:ffffff>Gandalf's Riddle</color>.
1919251571.55364: <color:ffffff>Gandalf's Riddle</color> is a puzzle minigame where you divide a given shape into similarly sized pieces using a specific number of cuts.
1919251571.55365: Play the minigame, collect stars, and earn rewards.
1919251571.55366: Various missions will also be available throughout the collab period.
1919251571.55367: There are Daily Missions and Weekly Missions, and completing them grants various rewards.
1919251571.55368: Lastly, don't forget to claim the special gifts that become available after a certain amount of time during the event.
1919251571.55370: Experience brand new battles in the new event dungeon, <color:ffffff>Subjugation Request</color>.
1919251571.55371: Each time you clear a stage, you can obtain grimoires with special effects.
1919251571.55372: Take on the <color:ffffff>Subjugation Request</color> together with Frieren Collab Monsters!
1919251571.55373: During the collab period, try out the new minigame, <color:ffffff>Summon Dice</color>.
1919251571.55374: <color:ffffff>Summon Dice</color> is a board game-style minigame where you equip items onto dice to battle enemies.
1919251571.55375: Play the minigame and collect new items to complete your collection.
1919251571.55376: Various missions will also be available throughout the collab period.
1919251571.55377: There are Daily Missions and Weekly Missions, and completing them grants various rewards.
1919251571.55378: Lastly, don't forget to claim the special gifts that become available after a certain amount of time during the event.
1919251571.55420:
Collab missions are divided into Daily Missions and Weekly Missions.
You get <color:ffffff>3 Daily Missions every day at midnight and 5 Weekly Missions every Monday</color>.
The number and content of Weekly Missions may differ during the first and final weeks of the event.
1919251571.55421: You can check mission details here. Completing missions grants rewards as well as Mission EXP.
1919251571.55422:
Earn Mission EXP to increase your Mission Reward Level and receive rewards at each level.
You can check detailed rewards for each level by pressing the <color:ffffff>Reward Info</color> button.
1919251571.55423: Earn Mission EXP to increase the mission reward level and get rewards for each level.
1919251571.55424: Check the detailed rewards for each level from the [Info] button.
1919251571.55430: Let us introduce the new minigame, Summon Dice.
1919251571.55431: Summon Dice is a minigame where you roll dice to activate various effects and battle enemies.
1919251571.55432: First, let us explain from the game preparation phase. Please press [Ready] first.
1919251571.55434: This is where you can select items to start the game with and equip them onto the dice.
1919251571.55435: This is where you can check the Monster you will play with and the items equipped on each die.
1919251571.55436: You can equip an item to each die value, and freely rearrange equipped items by dragging them.
1919251571.55437: This is where you can check the items available for use and their info.
1919251571.55438: More starting items will be available as you unlock more items through gameplay, allowing you to combine various items.
1919251571.55439: To equip a starting item onto a die, drag it to the desired die value.
1919251571.55441: You can earn Skill Points each time a battle ends, and you can use the points here to upgrade skills.
1919251571.55442: Skill upgrades consist of permanently applied effects, and their effects increase further each time you level them up.
1919251571.55443: You can check your available points here, and skill upgrades can be reset at any time to be redistributed.
1919251571.55501: You can play Minigame: Gwent here during the collab period.
1919251571.55502: 5 stages are available every week, and you can obtain a Weekly Reward upon clearing all the stages.
1919251571.55503: Let's start playing to learn about the game!
1919251571.55505: This is the Starter Deck you'll be playing with. You can check the deck name and its unique effect here.
1919251571.55506: Let's tap START and play as Durand Deck.
1919251571.55540: This is the game screen you will see when Summon Dice starts.
1919251571.55541: The enemy Monsters you will face are positioned at the top, and your Monsters are at the bottom.
1919251571.55542: You can check the items you equipped on the game preparation screen, and you can press and hold an item to see its detailed effects.
